/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from solution import load_people

checks = 0
def good(text, expected):
    global checks
    assert load_people(text) == expected, repr(text)
    checks += 1

def bad(text):
    global checks
    try:
        load_people(text)
    except ValueError:
        checks += 1
    else:
        raise AssertionError(repr(text))

h = 'name,email,age,active\\n'
good('\\ufeff active , age , email , name \\r\\n TRUE,00130, A@B , \"ignored\"\\r\\n'.replace(' \"ignored\"', 'Sam'), [{'name':'Sam', 'email':'a@b', 'age':130, 'active':True}])
good(h + '\"A, B\\nC \"\"D\"\"\", A@B ,0,FaLsE\\n', [{'name':'A, B\\nC \"D\"', 'email':'a@b', 'age':0, 'active':False}])
good(h + '\\n , , \\n,,,,,,\\n', [])
good(h, [])
for active, expected in [('true', True), ('TRUE', True), ('1', True), ('false', False), ('FaLsE', False), ('0', False), ('', False)]:
    good(h + f'Sam,a@b,,{active}', [{'name':'Sam','email':'a@b','age':None,'active':expected}])
good(h + 'Sam,a@b,' + '0'*5000 + '130,1', [{'name':'Sam','email':'a@b','age':130,'active':True}])
for text in ['', '\\ufeff', '\\n'+h, 'name,email,age\\n', 'name,email,age,active,other\\n', 'name,email,age,name\\n', '\\ufeff\\ufeff'+h]:
    bad(text)
for row in ['Sam,a@b,1', 'Sam,a@b,1,true,extra', ',a@b,1,true', 'Sam,,1,true', 'Sam,a@@b,1,true', 'Sam,@b,1,true', 'Sam,a@,1,true', 'Sam,a @b,1,true', 'Sam,a@b\\u00a0c,1,true', 'Sam,a@b,-1,true', 'Sam,a@b,+1,true', 'Sam,a@b,1.0,true', 'Sam,a@b,١,true', 'Sam,a@b,１２,true', 'Sam,a@b,131,true', 'Sam,a@b,99999999999999999999,true', 'Sam,a@b,1,yes', 'Sa\"m,a@b,1,true', '\"Sam\"x,a@b,1,true', '\"Sam,a@b,1,true', ' \"Sam\",a@b,1,true']:
    bad(h + row)
bad(h + 'Sam,a@b,1,true\\nBad,b@c,131,false')
for newline in ['\\n', '\\r', '\\r\\n']:
    good(newline.join(['name,email,age,active', 'Sam,a@b,30,0', '']), [{'name':'Sam','email':'a@b','age':30,'active':False}])
print(f'{checks} additional checks passed')
PY
 git diff --check
 git diff -- solution.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast
source = Path('solution.py').read_text()
ast.parse(source)
assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in source.splitlines())
print('Source syntax and whitespace checks passed')
print(source)
PY"
